features: [POWERFUL AUDIO] Proudly Made in India, the Tronica Super King 5.1 Bluetooth Home Theater System delivers 40W powerful sound output with loud, clear audio for TV, music, movies, gaming and home entertainment. The dedicated subwoofer adds deep bass and punchy sound, making it ideal for living rooms, bedrooms and indoor parties.

[VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS]: Enjoy wireless Bluetooth streaming from smartphones, tablets, and laptops. Also supports USB, SD card, AUX input, and built-in FM radio. Compatible with Android, iOS, PC, and all standard audio devices for flexible use anywhere.

[5.1 MULTIMEDIA SPEAKER SETUP] Experience immersive sound with a 5-speaker plus 1-subwoofer setup that spreads vocals, music and bass across your room. Perfect for movies, web series, gaming, music listening and house parties. Note: Operates on multi-channel sound distribution setup and does not support virtual Dolby or true surround decoding.

[FULL-FUNCTION REMOTE CONTROL] Control your home theater speaker system easily from your sofa with the included remote control. Switch modes, adjust volume, change FM stations and skip tracks instantly for a convenient wireless audio experience while watching TV, listening to music or enjoying entertainment.

[UNIVERSAL MULTI-INPUT CONNECTIVITY] Connect easily through Bluetooth, USB, SD card, AUX input and built-in FM radio. Stream music wirelessly from smartphones, laptops and tablets, or use plug-and-play options for pen drives and memory cards. Suitable for TV, laptop, phone, desktop, music system and home audio setup.
